title: Settle exact malformed Codex ENDs through managed refusal
outcome: An exact typed managed END with missing command text can seal a bounded refusal while preserving original identity and writer custody.
acceptance: Actual provider routing sends an exact completion with a missing command to the managed refusal path, keeping the original row and withholding artifact or credit.
An unproven or unrelated completion changes neither owner nor writer. An ordinary command preserves its established route.
